content: Now let me check existence of all 5 papers in the database by title.

args.sql:
SELECT id, title, year FROM `agentdb`.`paper` 
WHERE title IN (
    'FirmAgent: Leveraging Fuzzing to Assist LLM Agents with IoT Firmware Vulnerability Discovery',
    'PANGOLIN: Fuzzing Multilingual IoT Firmware with LLM-Driven Code Analysis',
    'Energy-Efficient Multi-LLM Reasoning for Binary-Free Zero-Day Detection in IoT Firmware',
    'Automated IoT Firmware Vulnerability Detection using Large Language Models',
    'Cracking IoT Security: Can LLMs Outsmart Static Analysis Tools?'
);
